verdict.rationale: Clerk's evidence only shows it publishing its own MCP server for other AI agents to consume Clerk's SDK docs (clerk-docs-2/26/-4), which is the opposite direction of the story — Clerk acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools. The 'eve' agent-authorization features (clerk-docs-11, -16, -27) discuss gating tool calls and OAuth brokering for agent tools, but there is no evidence Clerk itself connects to or consumes third-party MCP servers.
